default_policy.independence_rule: accounts in the same evidence_family count as one source

topic_queries.query: (AI OR data center) (grid OR interconnection OR transformer OR turbine OR power) has:links -is:retweet
topic_queries.purpose: surface emerging power, equipment, siting and queue constraints beyond the fixed scout list

topic_queries.query: (AI chip OR accelerator OR HBM OR CoWoS OR packaging) (yield OR supply OR capacity OR cost OR bottleneck) has:links -is:retweet
topic_queries.purpose: surface semiconductor bottleneck migration, qualification and supply-chain arguments

topic_queries.query: (AI data center OR AI cluster) (utilization OR cooling OR network OR outage OR financing OR TCO) has:links -is:retweet
topic_queries.purpose: surface operational and economic evidence that project announcements miss

topic_queries.query: (model OR agent) (inference cost OR system card OR task horizon OR open weights OR reliability) has:links -is:retweet
topic_queries.purpose: surface capability-cost, openness and deployment-control questions

topic_queries.query: (AI agent OR enterprise AI OR robotics) (productivity OR paid usage OR deployment OR failure OR workflow) has:links -is:retweet
topic_queries.purpose: surface adoption, workflow redesign and failure evidence

topic_queries.query: (CCS OR CCUS OR carbon capture) (FID OR EPC OR commissioning OR capture rate OR cancellation OR delay) has:links -is:retweet
topic_queries.purpose: surface project-conversion, delivery and operational evidence

topic_queries.query: (CCS OR CCUS OR CO2 storage) (financing OR tariff OR capacity contract OR cost OR utilization OR supply chain) has:links -is:retweet
topic_queries.purpose: surface capital, network utilization, cost and industry-formation arguments

topic_queries.query: (CCS OR CCUS OR carbon storage) (Class VI OR MRV OR liability OR permit OR cross-border OR policy) has:links -is:retweet
topic_queries.purpose: surface regulatory friction, policy durability and responsibility questions

scouts.name: Jesse Jenkins
limitations: energy-system interpretation is not a project or regulatory record; follow to the underlying paper, model or docket

scouts.name: Dylan Patel
limitations: SemiAnalysis sells research and consulting; modeled estimates and paywalled claims require methodology access and independent checks

scouts.name: SemiAnalysis
limitations: the organization account and Dylan Patel are one evidence family, not independent corroboration

scouts.name: Chip Huyen
limitations: technical commentary and personal experience require linked code, measurements or long-form methodology for factual use

scouts.name: Simon Willison
limitations: prefer the linked release, repository or full blog entry; brief model impressions are not benchmark evidence

scouts.name: Nathan Lambert
limitations: review current employment, advisory and commercial disclosures; follow technical claims to papers, artifacts or full essays

scouts.name: François Chollet
limitations: distinguish research results from personal forecasts and positions connected to current ventures or competitions

scouts.name: Andrej Karpathy
limitations: personal terminology, impressions and forecasts are context rather than measured adoption; recheck current affiliations

scouts.name: Hamel Husain
limitations: consulting and course activity can shape topic selection; factual claims require linked measurements, code or full methodology

scouts.name: Eugene Yan
limitations: personal writing may reflect employer experience; recheck affiliations and follow claims to disclosed methods or artifacts

scouts.name: Ethan Mollick
limitations: experiments and observations require the original study design, sample, comparator and outcome metric before factual use

scouts.name: Arvind Narayanan
limitations: critical commentary is a counter-evidence lead, not automatic refutation; follow to the cited study, dataset or analysis

scouts.name: Global CCS Institute
limitations: the Institute advocates CCS deployment; follow posts to the underlying report, project record or public policy document and preserve stakeholder attribution

scouts.name: IEA Greenhouse Gas R&D Programme
limitations: conference and social posts are discovery leads; use the full report, paper, proceedings or methodology before factual promotion
